text: Pile testing: a preliminary static compression test on at least two piles per pile type (loaded to 2.0 times the working load) and a static lateral test shall be carried out before the production piles are ordered (ALP-EPC-00000-CV-TST-0001, CV-TRP-0001); working piles shall receive integrity tests (100 %) and static tests on at least 1 % of the piles; the pile design basis is issued in ALP-EPC-00000-CV-RPT-0001.
